notes.title: Blasting Off from Early Access: STAR SHREDDERS Enters New Frontiers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31641146/06794554a5d9b522e084f0d4933922b6a0c5285d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Introduction[/h2]
Welcome aboard, space cadets! We’re thrilled to announce that after a stellar stint in Early Access, STAR SHREDDERS has officially graduated to a full release on Steam. As we journey from the development docks to the launch pad, we’re excited to share what this means for our beloved title and what’s next for our team.

[h2]Overview of STAR SHREDDERS[/h2]
STAR SHREDDERS is a rip-roaring shoot ’em up (SHMUP) that nods respectfully to the iconic 90s PlayStation era, mixing blistering action with a dash of strategy. You step into the boots of Clash, the dashing commander of the Valkyrie force, charged with saving the planet Roytera from the shadows of interstellar conflict. Armed with your wits and some serious firepower, you’ll dive into a universe where every dogfight is a test of skill and every mission, a story unfolds.

[h2]From Pen and Paper to Steam[/h2]
Embarking on the STAR SHREDDERS project was like charting a course through unexplored star systems. Starting off with nothing but pen and paper, we sketched out galaxies of ideas that slowly took form in the digital universe. This journey of bringing a concept to life as a fully-fledged game released on Steam has been incredibly enlightening.

Through the twists and turns of game development, we learned the importance of flexibility and adaptation. Turning sketches and daydreams into playable levels taught us about the technical intricacies of game design—from coding challenges to aesthetic decisions. Each step reinforced the value of patience and perseverance, especially in a field as dynamic as video gaming.

The community’s feedback was our North Star, guiding us to refine and iterate upon our initial ideas. Learning to incorporate constructive criticism constructively was pivotal; it not only improved STAR SHREDDERS but also taught us invaluable lessons about game development as a dialogue between creator and player.

This experience has been a cornerstone for our team, proving that taking a game from pen and paper to a global platform like Steam is not just a development process—it’s a journey of growth and learning. We’re grateful for every bit of knowledge gained, and we’re thrilled to leverage this in our future projects.

[h2]What’s New in the Full Release[/h2]
Here’s the scoop: the full release of STAR SHREDDERS will remain a compact prologue, featuring just one level. Why, you ask? Well, as we set our sights on new horizons and exciting projects, we’ve decided to put further development on hold. This single-level prologue is our way of giving you a taste of the universe we’ve crafted, packed with action and adventure, and leaving you hungry for what could have been—and what may yet be in our future endeavours.

[h2]Pricing Strategy[/h2]
In line with our prologue’s brief but brilliant showcase, we’ve tweaked the pricing to offer you fantastic value. It’s a small price for a slice of the cosmos, reflecting the epic experience that awaits even in this short adventure.

[h2]A New Frontier: Our Upcoming Project[/h2]
While STAR SHREDDERS takes a bow as a prologue, we’re not resting on our laurels. Our team is already busy plotting a course to new creative galaxies. We’re deep in the development of an exciting new project, and although we’re keeping the details under wraps for now, rest assured, more tantalising tidbits are on the way soon. Stay tuned!

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
So, what are you waiting for? Blast off to Steam, grab your copy of STAR SHREDDERS, and dive into the prologue that sets the stage for more cosmic tales. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see you engage with this snippet of our universe. Your feedback is more crucial than ever as it fuels our journey towards new adventures. Thanks for being a part of our crew—keep your eyes on the stars, and let the star shredding continue!

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 10th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/764090/header.jpg?t=1607542432[/img]

Firstly, thank you to all for playing STAR SHREDDERS and leaving your priceless feedback, we really appreciate the support!

We've made some small updates to help balance the experience for players, please find the list below.

Updates:
[list]
[*] Decreased the hitbox of the player, to allow for easier movement.
[*] Balanced the mine placement, some sections were very difficult to get past.
[*] Increased the amount of drones per section for more of a challenge and to have less empty space.
[/list]

Thank you for all the continued plays, It's always a pleasure seeing new entries on the leaderboard! 🤩

notes.title: STAR SHREDDERS 2020 Remaster Launch
notes.content:
We're really excited to announce that our remastered version of STAR SHREDDERS will be released on Steam come the 22nd November! 

We've been working really hard the past 2 years to bring you closer to the true vision for STAR SHREDDERS. We've made major updates on all fronts from art style, game engine, voice acting, weapons, music, Steam leaderboards and much more!

As always we're striving to make STAR SHREDDERS reach it's full potential, so we'll be reaching out again after launch to get all your feedback.

We want to thank all of you who have been supporting us through this journey, playing the game providing valuable feedback and leaving us reviews. We really appreciate it! ːsteamhappyː

[previewyoutube=qa59NLTA-OU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Star Shredders Remastered
notes.content:
Firstly, thanks to everyone supporting Star Shredders! 

It has been amazing to have players from around the world preview our Early Access build, providing insights on how to improve Star Shredders.

We have been actively updating the game to a point in which we completely scrapped the original engine and restarted from scratch! Every aspect of the game and the quality has risen to give players a greater experience.

It has been a challenge but we are getting closer to our initial vision of the game and how we showcase a compelling story matched with action packed gameplay!


[previewyoutube=NZRB402CYaI;full][/previewyoutube]

Coming 2020....

notes.title: Bug Fixes + Update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone

Firstly thank you so much for all the support, criticisms and feedback for STAR SHREDDERS! 

We are working for you now to complete this game and story for you all to experience. 

We are currently working some new content for the game but also some new mediums to showcase the story and the games progress.

Our lead developer has been hard at work, fixing some crucial bugs in the current build so expect some changes to happen but rest assure, it will be for the best! :)

As the Halloween sale is currently on, we have dropped the price for the festive season also so if you want others to help us, please spread the word!

Thank you again and have a rocking Halloween! As a treat, we have thrown in some concept artwork of Clash! 0_0 

Cheers,
Sharkbowl Games
